visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Smooth Colour Change With transition
visualizerParams.description: Type a button that changes colour when pressed, and fades between the colours over a third of a second. The transition goes on the normal state, so it works in both directions.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
<style>
  .btn {
    background: steelblue;
    color: white;
    transition: background-color 0.3s;
  }
  .btn:active { background: navy; }
</style>
<button class="btn">Press me</button>

checks.label: The button fades its background colour
